brief:
France Televisions removed the replay of a programme following remarks by actress Adèle Haenel criticising the situation in Gaza, Al Jazeera English reported. The broadcaster's decision came after Haenel spoke out on the matter publicly.

Details of the specific programme and the exact nature of Haenel's statements were not immediately available. The move reflects ongoing tensions in France around discourse on Gaza.
dek: France Televisions has removed the replay of a programme after actress Adèle Haenel denounced the Gaza genocide.
title: France Televisions pulls show after actress denounces Gaza genocide
